description:
In those days of youth, scarred and precarious, there was a forbidden zone marked off by adults. And in that place, I met the dangerous twins. Haru—rough on the outside but warm within. Yeongwon—always smiling, yet impossible to read. From whispers and rumors that surrounded them, the tangled love of the twin brothers begins in that forbidden place…

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/exclusion_zone), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/Prohibited/), [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/4419002159), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=5463113), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/comic/C000050469)
